nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template environment file listing the Neo4j connection variables (URI, username, password, database) the JARVIS backend reads to reach the graph store.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Operations manual governing the read-only JARVIS front end, documenting the four-projection chain from dev_graph markdown to Neo4j and graph.json, the component contract, and backend safety invariants.

nodes.name: JARVIS_INTEGRATION_ROADMAP.md
nodes.summary: Staged integration and refactor roadmap (Stages 0-5) covering ADR-010 governance, the graph.json exporter, the graph-driven console, the React refactor, the GraphRAG /ask uplink, and the voice bridge.

nodes.name: PROJECTION_SYNC_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Hardening plan to keep JARVIS projections consistent, recommending a single graph.json source, a unified resync script, an optional pre-commit hook, and a clear dashboard-chrome data contract.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Getting-started guide for the JARVIS dev_graph stack covering prerequisites, the offline explorer quick start, the containerized docker-compose stack, the GraphRAG console, and the React HUD.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Offline-first orchestration of the JARVIS stack defining a Neo4j 5 graph store with APOC, a read-only FastAPI traversal API, and an nginx static graph-explorer frontend wired by health-checked dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses external pre-existing volumes so the populated graph DB is adopted rather than recreated; host ports are remapped off Neo4j defaults to coexist with another stack.

nodes.name: neo4j
nodes.summary: Neo4j 5 community graph store with the APOC plugin, the canonical query store populated by sync_to_neo4j.py and consumed by the backend bridge and neo4j MCP.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Read-only FastAPI traversal service built from ./backend that issues READ-mode Cypher against the Neo4j service for the graph-explorer and /ask endpoints.

nodes.name: frontend
nodes.summary: Static graph-explorer UI served by nginx from the ./frontend directory, depending on the api service for live traversal data.

nodes.name: resync-devgraph.ps1
nodes.summary: Fail-fast re-projection script that atomically rebuilds every downstream consumer of the canonical dev_graph markdown by running sync_to_neo4j.py dry-run, then --clear, then export_graph_json.py for both graph.json copies.
nodes.languageNotes: Keys success off the '--- Summary ---' stdout marker because sync_to_neo4j.py returns exit 1 whenever any edge is skipped, making its exit code unreliable; stderr is left unredirected to dodge the PS 5.1 native-stderr ErrorRecord quirk.

nodes.name: Invoke-SyncStep
nodes.summary: Runs one sync_to_neo4j.py step, captures stdout, and throws unless the '--- Summary ---' marker is present, then echoes only the summary tail on success.

nodes.name: Invoke-ExportStep
nodes.summary: Runs export_graph_json.py and throws on any nonzero exit code, relying on the exporter's reliable exit status to detect crashes.

nodes.name: start.ps1
nodes.summary: Idempotent launcher that ensures the Neo4j container is up, builds the React HUD once if missing, then starts the read-only FastAPI bridge (serving the HUD) on 127.0.0.1:8000 in the foreground.
nodes.languageNotes: Falls back from `docker start` to `docker compose up -d neo4j` if the named container does not exist; serves the built HUD dist via uvicorn against backend/app.py.
